caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed against a plain, light beige background. The jug has a rounded body, a narrow neck that flares out at the rim, and a single handle attached at the upper left side. The surface of the jug is primarily a warm, light brown or tan color, with darker brown shading along the edges to indicate depth and curvature. There are decorative elements on the jug: a greenish, brushstroke-like design and several brown, leaf or branch-like patterns on its front. The jug’s rim and handle are outlined in darker brown. Subtle reddish and yellowish hues are visible near the base and around the neck, adding variation to the color. The overall style of the drawing is naturalistic, with the jug centrally positioned and no additional objects besides the artist's signature and date in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
